# Test fixtures for the matrix reading layer

All files here are **test data**. They come from the experiments of 28-29.10.2026 (EXP-18, branch `claude/els-axis-window-exp18-20261029`) and the canonical engine, and are served to the code through fakes.
Nothing here is a Fable reading, and nothing here is a verified finding of a real run: every result built from them carries `is_test_fixture: true`, `provider.kind: "test_double"` and `provider.live_model_call: false`.

| file | what it is |
|---|---|
| window-c1.json | the 23 x 41 Columbia window (rows 44-66, per-row md5 from public.torah_stream) |
| request-c2-general-cap60.json, request-c3-general-cap25.json | the exact requests that were sent in EXP-18 (previous general instruction, cap 60 / 25) |
| response-c3.json | the saved answer of run C3 (text, usage, cost); C2 ended at max_tokens |
| harness-classified-c3.json | the harness classification of that answer (the golden for the classifier) |
| engine-replay-c3.json | recorded els_verify_occurrence_v1 answers for the 25 occurrences |
| card-examples/*.json | example data for the card: every state of `els_matrix_reading_v1`, the Raziel answer text, the thread message and the session progress. Generated by `node test/helpers/els-matrix-reading-card-examples.mjs`; a test fails when they drift from the code |
